title: Agentic Legacy Modernization
subtitle: Modern APIs and internal apps for the systems of record you already trust.
description: Modernize legacy workflows incrementally. Discover existing terminal, COBOL and SOAP/XML interfaces; describe their contracts; expose validated OpenAPI-compatible adapters and build usable React front ends while retaining the underlying system's business behavior.

hero.alt: Vintage computer terminal in a dim room

includes.title: Discover and understand
includes.blurb: Inventory existing interfaces before changing how people access them.
bullets: COBOL copybooks, VSAM and mainframe dataset interfaces
TN3270 terminal workflows and screen fields
SOAP/XML services, schemas and transaction boundaries
Source mapping with documented assumptions and constraints

includes.title: Wrap with modern contracts
includes.blurb: Preserve business behavior through controlled adapters.
bullets: Typed canonical JSON for request and response models
Input validation, authentication and audit trails
Explicit error handling and regression tests

includes.title: Give teams a usable front end
includes.blurb: Create interfaces around the existing systems of record.

process.title: Inventory the contracts
process.blurb: Map existing transactions, message formats, dependencies and business rules. Define test fixtures and a safe integration boundary.

process.title: Wrap and validate
process.blurb: Generate adapters and OpenAPI descriptions, then compare output and error behavior with the legacy service using representative test cases.

process.title: Build and govern
process.blurb: Create a browser-based workflow with role-aware access, action logs, deployment documentation and an explicit review process.

cta.headline: Modernize access without rewriting the core
cta.blurb: Discuss a bounded legacy workflow and the right level of API wrapping, UI replacement and regression testing.
cta.chatPrompt: I want to modernize an existing terminal or SOAP/XML workflow using OpenAPI and an internal application.
